cards.english_title: Sri Lanka wants Korean partners at its 2027 expo
cards.korean_desc: 스리랑카는 1월 14일부터 17일까지 콜롬보에서 엑스포를 연다 스리랑카는 한국 기업에 기계와 장비를 요청한다 약 750개 기업과 1,500명이 참가한다 2026년 11월 14일 기업은 공급자를 확인해야 한다 대사관은 엑스포 전후에 기업을 연결한다
cards.english_desc: Sri Lanka will hold its Expo 2027 in Colombo from January 14 to 17. The country wants Korean firms to supply machinery, automation and renewable-energy equipment. About 750 exhibitors and 1,500 international participants are expected. On November 14, 2026, officials warned that companies must verify suppliers and regulations. The embassy plans introductions before the expo and follow-up after business meetings.
cards.hook: Sri Lanka wants buyers, not just visitors.
cards.takeaway_english: The expo may open doors, but careful business checks will decide whether they stay open.
cards.takeaway_korean: 엑스포가 문을 열어도 확인이 성패를 가른다

why_it_matters.english: Careful checks matter because expo participation does not prove financial strength.
why_it_matters.korean: 참가만으로 기업의 재정 상태를 알 수 없다

cards.korean_desc: 능동 서스펜션은 코너와 급제동에서 차체를 평평하게 했다 기본 카이엔은 그 기능 없이 높은 무게중심을 보였다 포르쉐는 이제 일상 운전자에게 기술을 설득해야 한다

cards.english_title: South Korea lost 3–2 despite more chances against Saudi Arabia
cards.korean_desc: 한국은 15번 슈팅했지만 기회를 덜 마무리했다 사우디는 후반 초반 3분 안에 두 골을 넣었다 이번 패배로 한국의 사우디전 무패 행진이 끝났다 손흥민은 한국이 11월 17일 카타르전을 준비해야 한다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: Korea created 15 shots, including six on target, but finished fewer chances. Saudi Arabia scored twice in three minutes after opening the match late in the first half. The defeat ended Korea’s six-match unbeaten run against Saudi Arabia. Son said Korea must prepare for Qatar in Doha on November 17.
cards.hook: South Korea had 15 shots. Saudi Arabia won 3–2.
cards.takeaway_english: The next match will show whether Korea’s promising play can become a result.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 경기는 좋은 경기력이 결과가 될지 보여준다

why_it_matters.english: The match exposed a gap between creating chances and finishing them.
why_it_matters.korean: 경기는 기회 만들기와 마무리의 차이를 보여줬다

why_it_matters.english: The team faces Qatar next and has little time to adjust.
why_it_matters.korean: 한국은 곧 카타르를 만나 조정할 시간이 적다

parties.label: South Korea
parties.english: It lost 3–2 and suffered its first defeat against Saudi Arabia since August 2005.

parties.label: Son Heung-min
parties.english: He regretted missing a chance and said the team must improve.

parties.label: Saudi Arabia
parties.english: It scored twice within three minutes and protected the lead.

views.english: He saw communication and determination as positive signs despite the result.
views.korean: 손흥민은 결과와 달리 소통과 투지를 긍정적으로 봤다

views.label: Korea JoongAng Daily
views.english: Its account emphasized Korea’s defensive collapse after conceding two quick goals.
views.korean: 중앙일보는 빠른 두 실점 뒤 수비 붕괴를 강조했다

disagree.english: Supporters may argue that the chances and two goals show improvement, not only failure.
disagree.korean: 팬들은 기회와 두 골이 실패만은 아니라고 말할 수 있다

cards.english_title: NewJeans Contract Fight Moves Beyond the Courts
cards.korean_desc: 11월 5일 조사는 멤버들이 미성년자일 때 계약을 살폈다. 소송은 손해와 책임과 창작물 유사성 주장을 다룬다. 법원은 어도어에 광고 계약 제출을 명령했다. 손해 소송 심리는 1월에 끝날 예정이다.
cards.english_desc: A November 5 investigation examined contracts signed when the members were minors. The lawsuits focus on alleged losses, responsibility and claims about creative copying. The court ordered ADOR to submit advertising contracts without delaying the damages review. The damages hearings are expected to finish in January.
cards.hook: NewJeans’ contract fight reaches public opinion.
cards.takeaway_english: The legal cases continue, while the contract debate may shape wider K-pop expectations.
cards.takeaway_korean: 소송은 계속되지만 계약 논쟁은 K팝 기준을 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Young artists may sign long contracts before fully understanding their consequences.
why_it_matters.korean: 어린 아티스트는 결과를 완전히 알기 전에 장기 계약을 맺을 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Court delays can affect whether performers return to work.
why_it_matters.korean: 법정 지연은 가수들의 활동 복귀에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The dispute raises questions about voices, likenesses and financial penalties.
why_it_matters.korean: 분쟁은 목소리와 초상과 금전적 위약금을 묻는다.

parties.label: ADOR
parties.english: It is seeking damages over NewJeans’ interrupted activities.
parties.korean: 어도어는 뉴진스 활동 중단 손해를 청구하고 있다.

parties.label: Danielle
parties.english: She faces the damages case but says delays affect her career.
parties.korean: 다니엘은 손해 소송을 겪으며 지연이 활동에 영향을 준다고 말한다.

parties.label: HYBE
parties.english: It defends the contracts and says minor protections were included.
parties.korean: 하이브는 계약과 미성년자 보호 조항을 옹호한다.

views.label: Artist-protection advocates
views.english: Contracts signed by minors deserve close attention because agencies receive broad rights.
views.korean: 미성년자가 쓴 계약은 회사 권리가 넓어 자세한 검토가 필요하다.

views.label: HYBE and ADOR
views.english: The agreements were negotiated with families and lawyers and followed legal standards.
views.korean: 계약은 가족과 변호사와 협의했고 법적 기준을 따랐다고 한다.

disagree.english: Critics dispute whether separate protections and standard clauses adequately protect young performers.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 별도 보호와 표준 조항이 젊은 가수를 충분히 지키는지 의문을 제기한다.

cards.english_title: China briefed Seoul on Kim Jong-un’s Dandong visit
cards.korean_desc: 왕이는 2026년 11월 13일 조현에게 김정은의 단둥 방문을 설명했다 김정은은 10월 24일 단둥에서 왕후닝을 만났다 한국 당국은 미북 대화가 가능하지만 크지 않다고 말했다 조현은 중국에 북한의 한반도 대화 복귀를 요청했다
cards.english_desc: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi briefed Cho Hyun about Kim Jong-un’s Dandong visit on November 13, 2026. Kim visited Dandong on October 24 and met senior Chinese official Wang Huning. South Korean officials said renewed US–North Korea talks were possible but not very likely. Cho urged China to help bring North Korea back to dialogue on peninsula issues.
cards.hook: China described ties with North Korea as mainly economic.
cards.korean_hook: 중국은 북중 관계가 주로 경제라고 설명했다
cards.takeaway_english: The briefing offered more detail, but the visit’s full political meaning remains uncertain.
cards.takeaway_korean: 설명은 늘었지만 방문의 정치적 의미는 아직 불확실하다

why_it_matters.english: China remains important to North Korea’s economy and diplomacy.
